title: Intrinsic conjugate before the final direct-image comparison
statement: For finite coefficients and composable scheme maps, the intrinsic derived conjugate equals the transported fixed-scalar mate coordinate followed by the inverse of the composite direct-image comparison.

source.place: The left-derived versus exact-derived adjunction identification in the intrinsic compositor normalization.

proof.text: Expand the coefficient-equivalence units in the ordinary pullback compositor. Naturality of the middle equivalence unit and of upperStarComp proves its compatibility with the three realization squares. Apply mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_comp to derive this equality, with the exact-localization compositor on each side.

Use the proved private conjugateRight_counit and squareCounit helpers in FiniteDirectCounitFixedRealizationTransport. The all-complex inverse direct-image comparison normalization supplies the derived unit equation. Transpose the resulting counit square under the intrinsic derived adjunction: its mate is exactly the inverse of sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison.

Apply mateEquiv_whiskerTop_conjugateEquiv to the derived compositor square from step 1. Horizontal mate pasting identifies the mate of the composite square with the two pasted inverse direct-image comparisons. Identify the fixed-scalar exact-derived adjunction with the left-derived adjunction using the proved exactProEtaleAdjunction_eq helper and expand leftDerivedUpperStarComp. This identifies the two fixed-scalar conjugates.

Precompose the mate-pasting equality with the two forward direct-image comparisons and cancel the inverse pairs. Substitute sfIntrinsicDirectComparisonTransport for the resulting fixed-scalar pasted expression. Its composite with the inverse comparison for f followed by g is exactly the asserted intrinsic conjugate.

proof_origin.place: Compositor mate pasting via the existing derived counit square, exact-localization composition, and Mathlib mate naturality; no split-off obligations.

from.place: Adjunction-coordinate portion of the abstract mate-pasting step.

lean.statement: theorem sfIntrinsicConjugateComparisonTransport (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A))) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective] : (conjugateIsoEquiv ((sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction g A).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction.comp (sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f A).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction) (sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction (f ≫ g) A).mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction (sfIntrinsicDerivedPullbackComp A f g)).hom.app ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X A).functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) = sfIntrinsicAmbientCoordinate A f g I (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) f g) ≫ (sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison (f ≫ g) A).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)
